cases.sentence: Соломон женился на дочери фараона, царя ___.
cases.translation: Solomon married the daughter of Pharaoh, king of Egypt.
cases.explain: The noun царь (king) of requires the genitive case.

cases.translation: He settled her in the city of David.
cases.explain: The preposition в (in) governs the prepositional case.

cases.sentence: Соломон любил ___ и следовал его наказам.
cases.translation: Solomon loved God and followed his instructions.
cases.explain: The verb любил (loved) governs the accusative case for the direct object.

cases.sentence: Царь отправился в ___ чтобы принести жертвы.
cases.translation: The king went to Gibeon to make sacrifices.
cases.explain: The verb отправился (went) with в requires the accusative case.

cases.sentence: В Гибеоне Господь явился Соломону во ___.
cases.translation: In Gibeon, the Lord appeared to Solomon in a dream.
cases.explain: The preposition во (in) governs the prepositional case.

cases.translation: Solomon asked God for a wise heart.
cases.explain: The verb просил (asked) with у requires the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Две ___ пришли к царю и встали перед ним.
cases.translation: Two women came to the king and stood before him.
cases.explain: The subject of the verb пришли requires the nominative case plural.

cases.translation: The king commanded to divide the living child in two.
cases.explain: The verb разрубить (to divide) governs the accusative case for the direct object.

reading.ru: Соломон женился на дочери фараона, царя Египта.
reading.question: Who did Solomon marry?
options: The daughter of Pharaoh, king of Egypt
reading.correct: The daughter of Pharaoh, king of Egypt
reading.explain: The text says Solomon женился на дочери фараона, царя Египта (married the daughter of Pharaoh, king of Egypt).

reading.ru: Соломон любил Господа, следуя наказам своего отца Давида.
reading.question: How did Solomon show his faithfulness?
options: By loving God and following David's instructions
reading.correct: By loving God and following David's instructions
reading.explain: The text states Solomon любил Господа, следуя наказам своего отца Давида (loved God, following David's instructions).

reading.ru: В Гибеоне Господь явился Соломону во сне ночью, и Бог сказал, Проси у меня, чего хочешь.
reading.question: Where did the Lord appear to Solomon, and what did He say?
options: In the temple, and He demanded worship
In Gibeon in a dream at night, saying 'Ask of me what you wish'
reading.correct: In Gibeon in a dream at night, saying 'Ask of me what you wish'
reading.explain: The text says В Гибеоне Господь явился Соломону во сне ... Проси у меня, чего хочешь (In Gibeon the Lord appeared to Solomon in a dream... Ask of me what you wish).

reading.ru: Соломон ответил, я совсем молод и не знаю, как исполнять свой долг.
reading.question: How did Solomon describe himself to God?
options: As a great and powerful king
As very young and not knowing how to perform his duty
As ready to conquer all nations
reading.correct: As very young and not knowing how to perform his duty
reading.explain: Solomon said я совсем молод и не знаю, как исполнять свой долг (I am very young and do not know how to perform my duty).

reading.ru: Две женщины-блудницы пришли к царю и встали перед ним.
reading.question: Who came before the king in the second part of this chapter?
reading.explain: The text says Две женщины-блудницы пришли к царю (Two prostitute women came to the king).

reading.ru: Царь сказал, Разрубите живого ребенка надвое и дайте половину одной и половину другой.
reading.question: What command did Solomon give to resolve the dispute?
options: Give the child to one woman
Divide the living child in two and give half to each
Ask who has the real child
reading.correct: Divide the living child in two and give half to each
reading.explain: The king said Разрубите живого ребенка надвое и дайте половину одной и половину другой (Divide the living child in two and give half to one and half to the other).
